headline: Channing Tatum talks unmade Gambit movie
post:
Superstar actor Channing Tatum recently opened up about his long-stalled solo superhero project, according to Screen Rant. Years ago, the star was cast to play Remy LeBeau, but the development process faced multiple hurdles. According to the report, the production cycled through three different directors, including Rupert Wyatt, Doug Liman, and Gore Verbinski, before the project ultimately stalled entirely when Disney acquired Fox. 

Tatum recently shared that he "would love there to be" a new solo movie and that he is "fighting" for the idea, provided he can secure a great director. He also revealed that he believes dodging the director's chair himself saved him from a total catastrophe.

Would you still want to see his solo film happen?

#ChanningTatum #Gambit #Marvel
original_title: Channing Tatum's Unmade Gambit Movie Explained

headline: Joe Johnston Almost Directed The Hulk
post:
Before bringing Steve Rogers to the screen in Captain America: The First Avenger, director Joe Johnston was reportedly once set to helm an Incredible Hulk feature film back in 1997.

Universal Pictures developed the project with Johnston and screenwriter Jonathan Hensleigh before it was eventually placed on the back burner, and Johnston later went on to direct other projects instead.

headline: Fantastic Four #67 heads to auction
post:
Adam Warlock has one of the most complicated origins in Marvel history. According to ComicBook.com, his debut spans multiple issues because creators teased his arrival across several comics before he finally got a name. Fantastic Four #67 features the first appearance of the character originally known as "Him" in a cocoon. Years later, he gained his iconic moniker in Marvel Premiere #1 and eventually joined the Guardians of the Galaxy on the big screen.

Now, a CGC-graded 9.8 near-mint copy of Fantastic Four #67 is up for auction through Heritage. The rare issue has already attracted bids exceeding $1.5k. Collectors continue debating which issue counts as his true first appearance, but Fantastic Four #67 has regained its status among fans.

What is your favorite Adam Warlock storyline? 🎨

#AdamWarlock #FantasticFour #MarvelComics
original_title: Adam Warlock Has One of Marvel’s Most Complicated Origins, And This Fantastic Four Comic Is at the Center of It

headline: Adam Driver joins X-Men as Mister Sinister
post:

Driver shared that the cool script and his desire to get the character right made it the perfect fit.
